title: Weight decay trade-off between fine-tuning and linear probing
description: Using a smaller weight decay during pretraining improves downstream performance on low-shot fine-tuning but degrades linear evaluation performance, requiring a compromise in the training schedule.
canonical_description: weight decay strategy trade-off between fine-tuning and linear evaluation performance

evidence.quote: Using a smaller weight decay during pretraining improves the downstream performance on ImageNet-1% when fine-tuning. However, this also leads to a degradation of performance in linear evaluation.
